question: My relationship manager said I'd get an OTP and should approve the next screen for my home loan. What did I approve?
text: Without knowing how your data was shared, I can't tell you what you approved. If it was through an Account Aggregator, you approved a consent artefact that names what financial information was requested, the purpose, who will receive it, and how long the consent lasts. If it was another method (like giving login credentials or uploading documents), different rules or no formal consent framework may apply.
citations: RBI Master Direction — NBFC Account Aggregator (Reserve Bank) Directions, 2016, cl. 6.3 (retrieved 2026-08-20)

 (a) validity of consent

 (b) specified dates and usage; and

 (c) the credentials of the Account Aggregator

 through appropriate means.
